Backend: 10/10 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_backend_iter6.py. Frontend: header leverage-slots-badge shows '1x · 10 slots · coinswitch' and updates to '2x · 8 slots · coinswitch' after Apply and back to '1x · 10 slots · coinswitch' after restore; account-controls-panel with all sub-testids present; account-apply-result shows '✓ Applied: num_slots=8, leverage=2'. slot-analytics-section has 10 rows; Bench LINK -> button becomes 'Resume' within ~6s and spread-slot-card-LINK shows PAUSED; resume restores. telegram-send-digest-btn present (not clicked in UI). basis-filter-toggle + checked basis-filter-checkbox; 10 spread-basis-<COIN> elements showing '%' values. 390px page has NO horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth==clientWidth==body.scrollWidth==390) — this fixes the ~224px regression from iter5. Bot left RUNNING, PAPER, 10 slots, leverage 1, no coins paused. 1 real Telegram digest sent.

Recharts warning: 'width(-1) height(-1) should be greater than 0' — the ResponsiveContainer briefly renders before parent has a layout size. Cosmetic; adds noise to console.
